_what: record.mjs --grade tournament: offline film-grade parameters (ffmpeg post chain applied in assembleFramestep AFTER the optional --ssaa lanczos downscale). Committed so every graded render is reproducible from the repo.
_provenance: an internal provenance record (the measurement record behind these numbers; not shipped with the app)
_dof_note: DOF is not part of this ffmpeg chain: --dof renders true accumulation-buffer bokeh in-page (deterministic golden-spiral aperture samples riding the --shutter sub-frames), so its params live on the CLI per shot (aperture radius in meters + --focus target), not in the grade.
